description: Get deployment — Returns a single deployment by id. The response includes status (`deployment_status`, `files_status`, `code_status`), commit metadata, timing, and any failure reason — sufficient to monitor progress without needing the dedicated logs endpoint for most use cases. For deployments created by an environment promote or rollback, the response also carries the saga columns (`env_version`, `source_env_id`, `source_deployment_id`, `aborted_by_deployment_id`, `note`, `actor_id`, `environment_name`, `environment_epoch`); these are null on legacy build-pipeline rows.
name: get_deployment
